note: Everybody in the world with a life rather than a habit — and the hero, who is a creature kind like any other so that everything which knows how to draw, animate and hit a creature knows how to do it to you. Fields are as described in beasts.json.

traveller.note: Walks the roads at a fixed pace with no run in it — a traveller never flees, because nothing on a road has ever given them cause to. The palettes are wide so that two on the same road are two people.
traveller.label: Traveller
lines: The road goes on and on...

villager.note: Slower than a traveller and with more of a life to lose. Their day is decided by their trade rather than by their kind, which is why the tree that drives them is filed under the job.
villager.label: Villager
lines: Not much happens in {village}, and we like it that way.
The well water here is the sweetest around.
Have you seen the old ruins?

shopkeeper.note: Barely moves, because a shopkeeper who wanders is a shop you cannot find. No hit points at all: the person you buy from is not a fight anybody gets to have.
shopkeeper.label: Shopkeeper
lines: Welcome, welcome! Have a look around.

note: You. A creature kind like any other, so everything that already knows how to draw, animate, herd and hit a creature knows how to do it to you.
The climb is the consequential number: 0.56 clears one terrace and nothing else in the world has it. It is what a mountain is for, and it is the free answer to every heavy thing underground.
hero.label: You
